text: 256-cell gate at the shipping default: 5/5 conditions survived the controls, 45/60, 1 DEPLOYABLE (OscillatorLaser). The NO_SPEAK_CODE VOID is closed, confirmed by two independent instruments.

PERSISTENCE blocks 10 of 12 engines, each on exactly one seed of five. Shuffling a failing series' own values passes the same rule 52.4% of the time; failing seeds spread 2/1/3/3/0, chi2=3.78 df=4 p~0.44. The failures carry no trend and no structure.

Which half rejects a corpse: rule alone leaks 18/35 at 32c and 89/175 at 256c (51.4% vs 50.9%); with the axes on, 0 at both. The four axes reject every corpse-cell and the five named conditions reject none the axes missed.

ConsciousnessEngine's 0/5 is about drive amplitude, not differentiation. Growth lives in a band with probabilistic shoulders: at 8 seeds x0.1 grows 0/8, x0.3 5/8, x0.5/x1.0/x3.0 8/8, x10 5/8, x30 0/8. The single-seed table had one error in each direction.

The deployed runtime stays at 2 cells. Its two drive paths separate completely at eight seeds: text_to_vector 0/8, raw byte/255 8/8, Fisher p = 0.000078. --max-cells raises a ceiling never approached.

The repair for an unreachable split bar is unreachable the same way, at two sites. consciousness_engine and mitosis both use mean(window) > q0.90; q90/mean EQUALS max/mean in both, so the bar IS the maximum and 0 of 1295 window means clear it. Annotated at both lines, not changed.

mitosis.text_to_vector sums over bytes and divides by characters, so the same sentence is a 1.65-2.32x stronger stimulus in Korean than in English. Correct divisor written at the site; not changed because three modules import it and CLAUDE.md requires training to restart from step 0 when data changes.

Three retractions in one stretch were one arithmetic error. For a binary per-seed outcome, a clean 3/3 sweep happens 67% of the time at a true rate of 0.875. Eight seeds is the floor and the count goes in the result.
CLAUDE.md and README claimed --max-cells 16/32 give Phi~14/28; measured, the runtime is at 2 cells whatever the flag says. Corrected in both, with Phi ~ cells left standing for the benchmark.
The runs behind every number in the gate audit moved from the scratchpad into state/gate-audit-2026-07-28/, including the runs that produced the retracted readings.
